# Method GetAxisByTwoPointsCreation

#### GetAxisByTwoPointsCreation(ElementId, out SmartPoint3D, out SmartPoint3D)

Gets points from an axis by two points creation operation.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 400, 140)]
void GetAxisByTwoPointsCreation(ElementId inElementId, out SmartPoint3D outFirstPoint, out SmartPoint3D outSecondPoint)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Identifier of the axis by two points creation operation to analyze  |  
 
|  SmartPoint3D |  outFirstPoint |  First point  |  
 
|  SmartPoint3D |  outSecondPoint |  Second point.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.20.
